source: claude-agent-sdk 0.2.181 through ClaudeSDKClient against a stub CLI that sends the mcp_message requests, jsonschema 4.26.0, on Darwin. Each case ran in a fresh process whose script imports claude_agent_sdk and connects; answers use the OK / ERR / RPCERR text format of python_schema.json.
assumptions: process lists the keys of re._cache in order when jsonschema.validate is first called; re._cache2 holds the same keys in the same order. A key of a str pattern compiled with no flags is that pattern, any other key (a bytes pattern, flags, or a pattern with a lone surrogate) is null. These are the patterns the imports of claude_agent_sdk and its dependencies compile, plus the version pattern subprocess_cli.py matches while connecting; a script that imports other modules or runs on another platform starts with others.

The deep tools nest the pattern under 117 levels of not and two properties, where check_schema's format check of a pattern that is not cached passes the recursion limit while compiling it, and one that is cached does not. Nothing wraps jsonschema.validate while a case runs, since one more frame below it moves where the limit falls.
The fillers are distinct patterns that allOf checks in array order; ^\d+$ is key 88 of process, so 61 newer keys plus 451 fillers make 512 newer patterns, which evicts it from _cache.

The SchemaError and UnknownType cases print a 100 character string nested in lists: _pprint_str splits its line with re.findall(r'\S*\s*', line), whose compile, while the pattern is not cached, reaches seven frames below findall, six deeper than the cached lookup. Under 324 lists that compile passes the recursion limit and the RecursionError escapes the handler, under 323 it fits, and under 325 only the cached lookup fits.

str() of a SchemaError ends in textwrap.dedent, which compiles (?m)^ followed by its 12 space margin, a pattern the process has not compiled before the first call; a SchemaError printing a long string compiles the word pattern as well, so 449 fillers and that SchemaError make 512 newer keys, as 450 fillers and one printing no long string do.

cases.name: a pattern the process compiled before the first call
a pattern the process never compiled
a pattern another tool's call compiled
a pattern the process compiled before the first call, after 450 other patterns
a pattern the process compiled before the first call, after 451 other patterns

a SchemaError printing a long string after another SchemaError compiled the word pattern
